title: Conference overnight staff pocket playbook
content:
Purpose: pocket operational notes for overnight staff (on-the-ground leads, vendors, and quick reimbursements). This is a working scratchpad — copy what's useful into the final ops playbook.

Top priorities (first 24h):
- Check-in with venue ops on arrival (ask for manager on duty + kitchen cutoff times).
- Confirm staff rooming list vs hotel list; any swaps email ops@redwood.com and DM #roadshow-houston.
- Confirm vendor load-in window and badge pick-up location.

Expense reminders (quick rules):
- Use company Ramp card when available; category = Events > Meals or Transportation. Put "Roadshow — Houston — <date>" in expense title.
- Cash petty: only for last-mile meals or tips. Limit $150 per team lead. Scan receipts within 48 hours and attach to Ramp expense.
- Per-diem (recommended): $65/day domestic (meals + incidentals). Use per-diem for vendors only when no invoice available.
- Taxis/ride-hail: put rider name and purpose in notes. If splitting, list names and amounts. Keep screenshots of driver/receipt.
- Reconciliation checklist: receipts, attendee list, vendor invoices, Ramp tx id, matching PO/Jira if applicable (OPS-1273).

Receipts scanning & naming convention:
- File name: YYYYMMDD_vendor_shortdesc_amount (e.g., 20260305_usdeli_boxlunch_423.75.jpg)
- Upload to Drive folder: /shared_drives/company/events/houston-2026/receipts (ops will move later).

Onsite vendor quick contacts (save to phone):
- Local AV: BrightWave Events — contact: Elena Torres, mobile +1-713-555-0129, elena@brightwave.events (primary for mics/projector)
- Catering: Southern Fork — contact: Marcus Lee, mobile +1-713-555-0344, invoices@southernfork.com (confirm vegetarian count by 8am)
- Freight/Drayage: Bay Logistics — contact: Raj Patel, office +1-281-555-0892, raj@baylogistics.co (driver ETA required)
- Hotel block liaison: FrontDesk Lead — Sara Kim, property +1-713-555-0987, sara.kim@hotelhouston.com (late check-out approvals)

Hotel & staff logistics (notes):
- Block name: Redwood Inference — confirm guaranteed room nights Friday–Sunday. Cutoff date: 2026-02-28.
- Staff keys: leave a small binder at concierge labeled "Redwood overnight" with list of phone ext and emergency contacts.
- Late arrivals: issue temporary keycode and text Sara with booking name + confirmation number.

Draft on-call rota (overnight leads):
- Lead A: Maya Chen (primary night contact, 9pm–3am)
- Lead B: Diego Alvarez (backup, 3am–7am)
- On-call escalation path: lead -> venue ops manager -> regional ops (Priya Rao) -> security (SRE-ops pager)

Common friction points to watch:
- AV handoff between sessions (request tech check 45m before event start)
- Vendor invoice delays (get PO or signed confirmation on day-of where possible)
- Credit card declines at hospitality vendors — have backup card + petty cash envelope ($200) at concierge

Unresolved / TODOs:
- Confirm whether catering can do boxed lunches for roundtable A (Dietary: 12 veg, 3 gluten-free). Action: Marcus by EOD 2026-03-02.
- Arrange a dedicated short-range WiFi AP for exhibitor check-in tablet. Jira ticket OPS-1273 assigned — follow up with infra team.
- Get printed attendee badges delivered to venue by 10am Saturday. Printer: PrintQuick (contact: Ana Ruiz) — need final attendee CSV by 2026-03-05.

Templates / copy for expense description (paste into Ramp notes):
- "Roadshow — Houston — Meals — Team dinner 2026-03-06 — Attendees: Maya C., Diego A. — Internal code: OPS-1273"
- "Roadshow — Houston — Taxi — Lead pickup to hotel — Driver: John D. — Receipt attached"

Notes to self:
- Keep last 3 receipts on my phone camera folder for immediate approvals.
- Ask finance if small honoraria for local volunteers requires 1099 handling (tag: finance-ask).

Quick links:
- Venue floorplan: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/venue-floorplans/houston-2026
- Badge CSV template (internal): https://confluence.redwood.internal/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=1134562

If anything goes sideways: call Priya 415-555-0199. If security incident: page SRE-ops immediately and escalate to Ops manager.

End of scratchpad — move finalized items to /shared_drives/company/events/houston-2026/playbook when stable.
